features: 【Real-Time LED Display & Intuitive Tracking】 Unlike traditional smart rings, the Aeoss features a built-in LED display that gives you instant access to your stats—like heart rate, time, and activity—directly on your finger. No need to constantly check your phone to see your progress.

【Comprehensive 24/7 Health Monitoring】 Take control of your wellness with precision sensors for Heart Rate (HR), Heart Rate Variability (HRV), and Blood Oxygen (SpO2) saturation. Get a complete picture of your cardiovascular health and recovery levels around the clock.

【Advanced Sleep Analysis】 Optimize your rest with in-depth sleep tracking. Our AI-driven app analyzes your light, deep, and REM sleep cycles, providing actionable insights to help you wake up feeling refreshed and ready to take on the day.

【9mm Ultra-Slim & Durable Design】 Engineered for comfort and style, the 10mm ultra-slim profile offers a "no-feel" wearing experience. Crafted with water-resistant materials, it’s designed to withstand daily handwashing, workouts, and rain.

【Portable Charging Case Included】 Never worry about battery life. The included sleek, transparent charging case protects your ring while providing multiple full charges on the go, making it the perfect companion for travel and busy lifestyles.
